integrity: The all-length theorem has a self-contained proof and two independently designed standard-library finite cross-checks; computations are explicitly not substituted for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: All claims concern indexed palindromic words, two distinct outputs of exactly one ordinary deletion, and finite alphabets of size at least two; not multi-deletion or arbitrary-word coding capacity. Unindexed historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Forest structure and sharp two-read deletion capacity of palindromic words
